tools.name: projul_whoami
tools.description: Show what the connected key can do: its name, access level (Read or ReadWrite), the company name, and the word the company uses for an estimate. Use it first to confirm the connection. Projul API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: projul_list_clients
tools.description: List active clients, newest first. Filter by name, email, phone, company or external reference. Archived clients appear only with include_archived. Projul API: GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: projul_get_client
tools.description: Get one active client by id (cus_…), with addresses, emails, phones, contacts and assigned people. Projul API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: projul_create_client
tools.description: Create a client, or return the existing one when a client with the same two names and an email or phone already exists (no duplicates). Needs an idempotency_key you make for this request. Projul API: POST /v1/customers.

tools.name: projul_list_projects
tools.description: List projects and leads (a lead is a project in a lead stage), newest first. Filter by status, stage, client, name or project number. Projul API: GET /v1/projects.

tools.name: projul_get_project
tools.description: Get one project or lead by id (prj_…), including assigned people, dates, address and lead source. Projul API: GET /v1/projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: projul_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates, newest first. Rows leave sections null: call projul_get_estimate for the line items. Filter by status, project or client. Projul API: GET /v1/estimates.

tools.name: projul_get_estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate by id (est_…) with its full tree: every version (the head and each change order), sections, line items and totals. Projul API: GET /v1/estimates/{estimate_id}.

tools.name: projul_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks and schedule items, newest first. Each row has its assignments (scheduled windows and people) and checklist steps. Filter by project, type, status, assignee or date window. Projul API: GET /v1/tasks.

tools.name: projul_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id (tsk_…) with its assignments, steps and recurrence rule (the raw iCal string). Projul API: GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}.

tools.name: projul_create_task
tools.description: Create a task, deadline, meeting, time-off entry or repeating series. task_type is required. Schedule it with assignments (people or teams and a start and end time). Needs an idempotency_key you make for this request. Projul API: POST /v1/tasks.

tools.name: projul_complete_task
tools.description: Set a task's completion state. `completed` states the result you want, so repeating the call changes nothing. For a repeating task, pass recurrence_date to complete one occurrence. Projul API: POST /v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete.

tools.name: projul_list_people
tools.description: List assignable people: active employees and subcontractors. Each id here can be assigned to a task. Filter by type, team or email. Projul API: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: projul_list_teams
tools.description: List teams (worker groups) with their member person ids. Projul API: GET /v1/teams.

tools.name: projul_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, newest first, with totals, balance due and status. Filter by number, client, project, estimate, status or overdue. Projul API: GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: projul_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id with its line items, discounts and payments so far. The customer share link is never returned. Projul API: GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: projul_list_messages
tools.description: List messages (notes, calls, site visits) on one record. Give parent_type and parent_id together. Projul API: GET /v1/messages.

tools.name: projul_add_message
tools.description: Add a note to a project, task, client or estimate. The note is stored in Projul; it is not sent to the client. Needs an idempotency_key you make for this request. Projul API: POST /v1/messages.

tools.name: projul_list_time_logs
tools.description: List time logs (hours worked), newest first. Filter by person, project, task, date range, time type or approval. Projul API: GET /v1/time_logs.

tools.name: projul_search
tools.description: Search clients, projects and leads, estimates, tasks and files for a text. Each match names its record type and id. Open a match with its get tool. Projul API: GET /v1/search.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: projul_list_clients, projul_get_client, projul_list_people, projul_list_messages · Private data: projul_get_client, projul_list_messages, projul_search · Public sink: projul_list_clients, projul_create_client, projul_create_task, projul_complete_task, projul_list_people, projul_get_invoice, projul_add_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: projul_list_clients, projul_get_client, projul_list_people, projul_list_messages · Private data: projul_get_client, projul_list_messages, projul_search · Public sink: projul_list_clients, projul_create_client, projul_create_task, projul_complete_task, projul_list_people, projul_get_invoice, projul_add_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
